name: mempalace-sharedbrain
description: Claude Code client for a MemPalace shared-brain hub: installs and keeps current the canonical rules block in CLAUDE.md without the mempalace package, composes the host:harness:project identity, carries the inbox cursor, checks the hub and the task inbox at session start, wakes the session on new coordination events, publishes what each machine can do and routes tasks to machines that meet their requirements, and keeps checkpoint and compaction saves working for a remote client.
